Code block inside a blockquote keeps its line indentation

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<blockquote><pre><code>line1\n    line2 indented</code></pre></blockquote>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
